name: Account Switch Request Redirection V 04
definition: The AccountSwitchRequestRedirection message is sent by the new account servicer to a central account switch servicer to set up the redirection of payment and collection transactions that are processed after completion of the account switch.  It is routed to the previous account servicer to signal that it should schedule the cancellation of all payment arrangements on the old account. This message may also be used by the new bank to amend the new account details, if the details previously provided were incorrect.

AccountSwitchDetails.name: Account Switch Details
AccountSwitchDetails.definition: Contains information about the details of the account switch.

NewAccount.name: New Account
NewAccount.definition: Account servicer holding the account to which the switch will be made for example the acquiring account servicer.

OldAccount.name: Old Account
OldAccount.definition: Account held at the old account servicer being switched to the new account servicer.

SupplementaryData.name: Supplementary Data
SupplementaryData.definition: Additional information that cannot be captured in the structured elements and/or any other specific block.
